answer: Jury duty summons history with court attestation is slow proof of a real civic life: summonses answered over several years. Each summons is issued by a court, answered in person, and filed, so a hundred fake jurors would need a hundred court dates and a hundred real appearances. The beacon is the court's own roll: names that never appear are simply absent. The ferrous an attacker faces is time, three answered summonses over six years, and no shortcut buys it. A forged ivory collapses on the first registry lookup.
